The file asserts that reading itself, with `B == 1` and `X == 4`. `go/types` records the object being declared in `Info.Uses` for those two names anyway, so the golden points a name at itself and scylla points it where the specification says it goes.

The file is the test for `cannot use type parameter declared in alias declaration as RHS`, and it writes `type A[P any] = P` inside `func _[P any]()`. `go/types` keeps the alias's own type parameters out of the scope its right-hand side resolves through, so the `P` after the `=` lands on the function's `P`; scylla's scope for a type declaration carries its type parameters and lands on the alias's own `P`. Both name a `P` that is in scope at that point, and only the diagnostic go/types raises separates them.
